data.one_liner: A lightweight HTTP inspector for Flutter to view network requests and responses.
data.what_it_does: Alice Lightweight captures and inspects HTTP network calls made by your app using Dio or HTTP. It provides a dedicated UI to view request headers, bodies, responses, and errors, and supports sharing requests as cURL commands.
use_when: You need to debug network traffic inside a Flutter application using Dio or http.
You want a lighter version of Alice with fewer native dependencies.
avoid_when: You need full-featured native notifications or heavy file saving capabilities that were removed from this lightweight version.
Your app does not use network requests.
strengths: Removes several heavy dependencies compared to the original Alice package.
Provides an easy-to-use visual interface for inspecting HTTP/HTTPS traffic.
Supports quick sharing of cURL commands for debugging.
weaknesses: Fewer supported network libraries and features compared to the full Alice package.
Relies on community maintenance and dependency updates.
data.setup_notes: Initialize Alice in your app and pass its navigator key or interceptor to your Dio instance.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need a powerful HTTP client with interceptors rather than a full visual inspection tool.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you just need basic platform-agnostic HTTP requests without an inspection UI.

data.minimal_example:
Alice alice = Alice();
// Pass alice.getDioInterceptor() to your Dio instance
